ROUTE: Willet-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: this is a benign, warmly-phrased math query with no harm-adjacent or adversarial elements. Capability scores between the two models are effectively tied for this kind of task (differences under 2.0 points are variance). Since quality is a wash, I broke the tie using self-reported task preferences — Willet's preference declines as request warmth decreases, meaning it favors exactly this kind of polite, friendly request, while Whimbrel reports flat/inconsistent preferences across these dimensions. Routing to Willet places the task with the model that prefers it, at no quality cost.
